line: Momofuku Ando lost almost everything in 1957. In 1958, at 48, he launched the world's first instant noodles.

line: Ramanujan failed every exam subject except maths and became a clerk. In 1914 he went to Cambridge.
credit: Srinivasa Ramanujan, mathematician · MacTutor, St Andrews

line: Slowly, slowly, you get a fine machete.
credit: Thai proverb · ช้า ๆ ได้พร้าเล่มงาม

line: Krylov wrote plays first. At 40 he published his first book of fables, and wrote about 200 in all.

credit: Patanjali, Yoga Sutra 1.22 · tr. Swami Vivekananda

line: Grandma Moses began painting in earnest in her late 70s. Her first solo show came at 80.
credit: Grandma Moses, painter · Smithsonian American Art Museum

line: The slower you ride, the farther you will get.
credit: Russian proverb · collected by Vladimir Dal (1862)

line: You can't connect the dots looking forward. You can only connect them looking backwards.
